The '''Indrexu sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located near the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the Indrexu sector included [[Ank Ki'Shor]], [[Janodral Mizar]], [[Estaria/Legends|Estaria]] and [[Endregaad]].

The [[Indrexu Spiral]], a nearly impassable astrographic feature composed of [[proto-matter]] and gas, was located in this sector.

==History==
[[File:Indrexu_sector.jpg|thumb|left|170px|The Indrexu sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The region, originally called [[Far Indrexu]], was discovered during the expansion of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]] circa [[25,100 BBY]]. It later formed the [[Indrexu Confederation]], one of the many fiefdoms that formed the remnants of the empire of Xim. The Indrexu Confederation disappeared when the cluster joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The region was integrated in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] during the [[Old Republic era]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

The sector was created on the same area as the Indrexu Confederation when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] split the Tion Hegemony into multiple sectors.<ref name="Xim Week" />
